title: 8-bit adder with carry
description: Nine output bits preserve the carry: try 255 + 1.

title: 8-bit ALU
description: op: 0 add, 1 subtract, 2 XOR, 3 shift left. Compare flags are separate outputs.

title: 4 × 4-bit multiplier
description: Two runtime inputs produce the complete eight-bit product.

title: Bit routing and reductions
description: Swap nibbles, mask a byte, and compute parity and an AND reduction.

title: Signed arithmetic and shifts
description: Signed eight-bit inputs produce a full sum and product. Arithmetic right shift preserves the sign.

title: Combinational always block
description: Blocking assignments and case choose add, subtract, XOR, or packed low nibbles. The ninth bit preserves carry/borrow.

title: Two-cell hierarchical adder
description: Two parameterized four-bit adder instances connect through a carry wire and output slices.

title: Dynamic selects and slice updates
description: Read a bit, read a guarded three-bit window, and patch a slice. Indices above 7 produce a checked read error.

title: Population count with a for loop
description: Eight blocking additions are unrolled at compilation. The output counts the set bits in the input byte.

title: Generated XOR lanes
description: Eight generated scopes each instantiate a one-bit XOR cell. Change either byte to run all lanes in the font.

title: Function and small array
description: index: 0 selects a, 1 b, 2 a XOR b, 3 NOT a. Indices 4–7 produce a checked array read error.

title: Signed and unsigned division
description: Compare signed and unsigned quotient/remainder for the same input bits. A zero divisor produces a checked error.

title: Parameterized adder and mask
description: WIDTH and MASK specialize the font at build time. This font uses WIDTH=8 and MASK=0xA5.
